question: Does this exact exported dataset, sanitized SQLite bundle, and fail-closed reader/writer capability contract match the intended supported cloud-v2 privacy and rollout boundary?
rationale: The PR establishes durable sensitive-data publication and coordinated deployment semantics across gitcrawl, crawlkit, and crawl-remote; source review and green CI cannot determine that product and security boundary alone.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the full contract after redacted deployed-service evidence covers stage-only publication, inactive-snapshot resume, reader queries, artifact privacy, and final cutover.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce optional datasets or publication modes if the complete privacy and rollout surface cannot yet be demonstrated safely.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
